csv.detail: Both versions emit the same ten-column by-file CSV header. v3 has no --no-config flag, so its controlled baseline was run from the checked-in corpus directory without an SCC config; v4 uses --no-config.

providerAndPath.detail: All ten corpus paths retained their Provider and Filename identities, including the path containing spaces.

code.detail: All corpus Code values are identical between 3.7.0 and 4.0.0.

complexity.detail: SCC v4 counts Rust question-mark error propagation in Complexity; this is the upstream Rust ? complexity correction represented by the fixture.

recordsAndFindings.detail: The threshold-finding fixture remains 374 Code / 740 Complexity in both versions, so its code-line Record and non-blocking finding are unchanged. The Rust correction remains below the default low-decision threshold and produces no Record/finding drift.

privateConfig.detail: The controlled v4 default has the required CSV/path/measurement contract. No remap, generated, ignore, or complexity override is necessary; creating an empty private config would add no stable product semantics.
